composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-114a "BILGE SYSTEM") serves the vessel's bilge water removal function, split across three distinct sub-systems named by the sheet's own boxes/labels: (1) the MAIN BILGE PUMP with its multi-switch control loop (top-right of sheet), (2) the five electrically-actuated BILGE VALVES (Burkert rotary actuators on ball valves) each paired with a compartment bilge-level switch feeding open/closed status to the main panel, and (3) the MAIN PANEL / ONYX monitoring interface (PLUG C, PLUG D, MAIN PANEL PC CARD) that reports valve state and lets the operator command the pump/valves remotely. Per engineer red-pen, the aux bilge pumps (mast + eng room, Whale Gulper 320) and the fire pump are SEPARATE physical units not shown wired on this sheet — they belong to 520-aux-bilge-pumps and 520-fire-pump respectively and are not composed here since no drawn loop for them appears on GMMS 108'-114a.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Sheet's top-right shows 'MAIN BILGE PUMP' motor symbol with + supply and ground return, fed via SW8/SO6/T-S S local-switch loop and monitored/commanded via MAIN PANEL PC CARD and ONYX taps XA11-32. Engineer red-pen (control_loop fact) confirms this is the main bilge pump loop with three alternative activation paths.

functions.label: Main bilge pump run command (multi-switch activation)
functions.what_it_does: Runs the main bilge pump motor to discharge bilge water; the pump's contactor coil (behind T/S S terminals 13/14) can be closed by any of three alternative sources, giving local, panel, and remote control redundancy.

flow_scenarios.path: Pump motor idle; contactor coil open; +24V SERVICE BAT via F2 200A stands ready at the supply rail but is not applied to the motor until one of the activation paths below closes the coil.
LOCAL PUMP SW (front of T/S S) closes -> T/S S terminals 13/14 -> closes solenoid contactor coil -> +24V feed reaches MAIN BILGE PUMP motor -> return to ground/hull negative bus.
MAIN PANEL switch S13 (BILGE PUMP SW) -> PLUG C pins 6/7 -> same T/S S 13/14 contactor coil circuit -> pump motor -> ground return.

ONYX command via XA11 tag pin 32 -> cable/terminal 50 -> switched through relay Re6 -> closes T/S S 13/14 contactor circuit -> pump motor -> ground return. (per engineer red-pen; XA40/XA10 tags elsewhere on this sheet are STATUS taps, not command inputs for this pump.)

key_components: contactor/solenoid coil at T/S S terminals 13/14 (fused terminal 13 per netlist)
relay Re6 (switching element for ONYX remote path)
functions.dry_data: 24V DC contactor-controlled motor; fed from +24V SERVICE BAT via F2 200A fuse (main supply feeder, upstream of this sheet's local loop); F7 60A fuse also documented on the +24V DC distribution sheet for this load.
functions.sheet_region: top-right (MAIN BILGE PUMP symbol) and top-left (F3 60A / SW8 / SO6 / T/S S local switch block)

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Five repeated 'BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE' motor+OPEN/CLOSE-switch stations wired through T/S C terminals 1-50, fed from relay bank Re1-Re6 which is fed from breaker Q13 (BILGE VALVES 10A) via T/S B. Matches register mapping BILGE VALVES -> 520-bilge-valves and BOM identity (Burkert DN050 ball valves with electric rotary actuators).

functions.label: Bilge valve open/close control (5 valve stations)
functions.what_it_does: Each of the 5 Burkert rotary-actuated bilge valves (serving PORT/STBD Lazarette, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, and Sail Locker bilge suction lines feeding the main bilge manifold) is driven open or closed by a local OPEN/CLOSE switch pair wired through the T/S C terminal strip; state is reported to the main panel.

flow_scenarios.path: Valve actuator motor at rest; +24V feed present at T/S B (via Q13 10A breaker) but not applied to motor until an OPEN or CLOSE switch is closed.

OPEN switch closes T/S C terminal 7 -> feeds valve motor terminal [2] via T/S C 9 -> motor rotates valve open -> valve opens the associated bilge compartment suction line into the main bilge pump manifold.
CLOSE switch closes T/S C terminal 8 -> feeds valve motor terminal [3] via T/S C 10 -> motor rotates valve closed -> isolates that compartment's suction line.

Same OPEN/CLOSE switch-pair-to-motor pattern repeats at T/S C terminal groups 16/17→18/19, 24/25→26/27, 32/33→34/35(+XA11-32 ONYX tap on station with OPEN-2), 40/41→42/43, each driving its own valve motor for its named compartment (Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker, and Port/Stbd Lazarette bilge lines).

key_components: 5x Burkert rotary electric actuator + DN050 ball valve
OPEN/CLOSE pushbutton/switch pairs (local, at T/S C)
relay bank Re1-Re5 (coil fed from T/S B via Q13 10A breaker)
XA40/XA10 status taps off relays Re1-Re4 (status_signal to monitoring, NOT commands — per measured tag direction)
functions.dry_data: 24V DC electric rotary actuators; fed from Q13 BILGE VALVES breaker 10A via T/S B and relay bank Re1-Re5.
functions.sheet_region: center (T/S C terminal strip 1-50, valve motor + switch group, bbox ~0.38-0.72, 0.26-0.79)

functions.label: Compartment bilge-level switch monitoring (indicator loop)
functions.what_it_does: Each bilge compartment (Port/Stbd Lazarette, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker) has its own float/bilge switch that reports water presence; its + side taps directly off the associated bilge valve motor line, while the return/negative side is not traced on this sheet.

flow_scenarios.path: BILGE SW open, no signal to monitoring.

Compartment BILGE SW closes -> + feed taken from a tap on the corresponding BILGE VALVE motor line -> signal toward main panel/monitoring lamps; negative/return side of each switch is NOT traced on this sheet (INCOMPLETE per engineer rule).

key_components: 6x compartment bilge switches (Port Laz, Stbd Laz, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker)
functions.dry_data: Switch type/rating not printed; presence only.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Main Panel / ONYX Bilge Monitoring Interface
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: PLUG C / PLUG D / MAIN PANEL PC CARD region is explicitly labeled 'MAIN PANEL' with switches S13/S20-S24 and open/closed status lamps for each bilge zone; register maps MAIN PANEL -> 641-vessel-control-panel. This is the panel-side termination of the bilge system's control/status wiring, distinct from the bilge equipment itself.

functions.label: Bilge zone status indication and pump/valve command switches
functions.what_it_does: Provides the main panel operator with per-zone bilge switches (S20 Lazarette, S21 Aft, S22 Eng Room, S23 Fwd, S24 Sail Locker) and pump switch S13, plus open/closed LED-style status indicators for each bilge valve zone (PLUG D / MAIN PANEL PC CARD terminals 1-12) sourced through a diode array off a common +24V bus.

flow_scenarios.path: Each valve zone's open or closed contact -> PLUG C -> PLUG D -> MAIN PANEL PC CARD terminal (e.g. terminal 3/4 = Aft Bilge open/closed, 5/6 = Eng Room, 7/8 = Fwd, 9/10 = Sail Locker) -> lamp lit via a diode fed from the common +24V bus, with the +24V bus return traced to a chassis/earth ground symbol.

Main panel switches S13, S20-S23 (S24 confirmed on net for Sail Locker) close onto PLUG C pins, feeding the corresponding bilge pump/valve control loop (see 520-main-bilge-pump and 520-bilge-valves function scenarios above); the negative/positive full path for these panel switches beyond the plug is not fully traced on this sheet.

PEDESTAL ALARM MOD (speaker) taps PLUG C pin 8 (+) with mute switch on pins 9/10/11; feeds an audible alarm for the bilge system; positive supply for the alarm module itself is not fully traced on this sheet (only its plug-C tap is drawn).

key_components: diode array (5 diodes) feeding indicator lamps from common +24V bus
PLUG C / PLUG D terminal blocks
functions.dry_data: MAIN PANEL PC CARD terminals 1-12, some terminal labels illegible per sheet's own legend (terminals 5, 11, 12); 24V DC signal level.
functions.sheet_region: bottom-right (MAIN PANEL / PLUG C / PLUG D / MAIN PANEL PC CARD, bbox ~0.6-0.99, 0.66-1.0)

infrastructure.system_name: Bilge system supply feeders (F3 60A, SW8, SO6, F2 200A, Q13 10A)
facts: F3 60A fuse feeds SW8 switch feeding SO6 relay/solenoid, whose contacts feed T/S S terminals 13/14 (local pump switch loop) — supply origin for the main bilge pump local control leg.
F2 200A fuse feeds the +24V SERVICE BAT rail, which also supplies the XA11-32 ONYX tap junction/loop for the bilge pump remote command path.
Q13 BILGE VALVES breaker 10A feeds T/S B terminals 8/9/10, which feed relay coils Re1/Re2/Re3 (and further Re4/Re5) for the bilge valve actuator bank.

infrastructure.system_name: T/S B and T/S C terminal strips / Re1-Re6 relay bank
facts: T/S C is a large numbered terminal strip (terminals 1-50) distributing OPEN/CLOSE switch and valve-motor wiring for all 5 bilge valve stations plus the local pump switch feed-through (terminals 7-10).
Terminal 13 on T/S S carries a built-in replaceable fuse (measured netlist) — a known troubleshooting culprit for the local pump switch loop.
Re1-Re6 relay column bridges T/S B (Q13-fed) to T/S C and to monitoring taps XA40/XA10 (status only) and XA11 (ONYX loop, feeding Re6).
